description:
Join to apply for the Perinatal Sonographer-2 role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Perinatal Sonographer participates in the care of the patient, under the direct supervision of the Physician and in collaboration with the healthcare team by performing various fetal examinations, assisting in invasive procedures, reporting results of sonographic examinations, and ensuring patient safety and comfort during ultrasound procedures. The ideal candidate will specialize in high-risk obstetric imaging and be passionate about delivering exceptional prenatal care in a supportive and collaborative family focused environment alongside perinatologists and other healthcare professionals. This full-time position offers a 4-day work week to promote work-life balance without compromising patient care. Responsible for daily operations of the sonographic laboratory, equipment performance, and clinical sonographic quality assessment. Assumes responsibility and is accountable for adherence to Howard University FPP Privacy Policy policies and procedures, as well as all applicable federal and state laws as they pertain to healthcare and employment.

Supervisory Authority

None

Nature And Scope

  • Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered by the attending physician.
  • Acquire and analyze data obtained using ultrasound and related diagnostic technologies.
  • Meet examination components as defined by Maternal-Fetal Medicine Division, department procedures, established protocols, and AIUM’s examination guidelines.
  • Greet patients and guests, explain ultrasound procedures, prepare patients for appropriate examination according to department policies. Support patients and their families in a compassionate manner.
  • Verify accuracy of ultrasound requisition by checking physician’s orders in the patient’s medical record.
  • Interview patients to gather history pertinent to the ultrasound examination.
  • Use independent judgment and systematic problem-solving methods to produce high quality diagnostic information and optimize patient care.

Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, acompanhando sprints, validando entregas e tomando decisões ágeis para maximizar o valor entregue ao usuário.


Main responsibilities



  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, criando e mantendo uma lista clara e priorizada de funcionalidades, melhorias e correções que precisam ser desenvolvidas. A priorização deverá ser feita com base em critérios como valor de negócio, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica.

  • Detalhar requisitos e funcionalidades sob a forma de histórias de usuário (user stories), fornecendo critérios de aceitação claros e compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.

  • Garantir que o backlog esteja sempre refinado, constantemente atualizado com feedbacks do cliente e equipe, removendo itens obsoletos ou não mais relevantes.

  • Definir a visão do produto, articulada com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as necessidades do mercado.

  • Mapear a jornada do cliente, entendendo profundamente quem são os usuários, seus problemas e como o produto pode atender a essas necessidades ao longo da sua jornada.

  • Definir as entregas e marcos (milestones) ao longo do tempo, garantindo que haja uma estratégia clara de desenvolvimento e evolução do produto.

  • Negociar e alinhar as expectativas dos stakeholders internos e externos.

  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes: agir como o ponto central de comunicação entre os times técnicos, stakeholders e usuários, evitando mal-entendidos e desentendimentos.

  • Garantir que os objetivos das sprints sejam cumpridos, fornecendo feedback constante e eliminando possíveis impedimentos.

  • Avaliar cada incremento do produto desenvolvido pelo time, verificando se os critérios de aceitação foram cumpridos e se a entrega atende às expectativas do cliente e do mercado.

  • Ser ágil ao tomar decisões, tanto no que diz respeito a novas funcionalidades quanto à manutenção do escopo e à priorização de correções.

  • Balancear o que é tecnicamente possível com o que é economicamente viável, sempre levando em consideração o valor que será entregue ao usuário.


Requirements and skills



  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, priorização de funcionalidades e ciclo de vida do produto.

  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e outras metodologias ágeis.

  • Excel avançado.

  • Experiência em criação de histórias de usuário bem definidas, com critérios de aceitação claros e objetivos.

  • Experiência com negociação de prazos, funcionalidades e recursos, equilibrando as demandas do negócio com as limitações técnicas.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Power Electronics Developer – TechnipFMC

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

Equal rights TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

description:
Overview

Mecânico de Manutenção - (Máquinas pesadas) – Descrição do papel: o Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. Este profissional realizará diagnósticos e reparos em sistemas elétricos, de refrigeração e mecânica hidráulica, atuando na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de Guindastes LIEBHERR e FUWA, Empilhadeiras HYUNDAI e HYSTER, e equipamentos da Linha Amarela, incluindo máquinas Volvo e Caterpillar. Será essencial a leitura e interpretação de diagramas para identificação e resolução de falhas, bem como a substituição precisa de peças e componentes. O(a) Mecânico(a) deverá assegurar a conformidade das manutenções com as normas de segurança (como NBR 15965), gerenciar e priorizar tarefas sob prazos, lidar dinamicamente com múltiplas demandas, aplicar senso crítico e de urgência na resolução de problemas e manter atenção rigorosa aos detalhes em todas as etapas, além de preencher relatórios de serviço e registros de manutenção de forma precisa e organizada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e defeitos mecânicos em sistemas diversos.
  • Fazer ajustes e regulagens em componentes mecânicos.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento de máquinas, identificando a necessidade de reparos.
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades de manutenção realizadas.
  • Colaborar na montagem e desmonte de equipamentos, conforme necessário.
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção de registros e documentação técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Amplo conhecimento em elétrica para manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Conhecimento Mecânico Hidráulico.
  • Leitura de diagramas e identificação de falhas.

Grupo Transfero é uma empresa internacional com sede em Zug, Suíça, no coração do Crypto Valley. title: Coordenador(a) de Data & Analytics - L'Oréal Corporativo
description:
Overview

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

A posição de Coordenador(a) de Data & Analytics para divisão L’Oréal Grande Público desempenhará um papel fundamental na transformação de dados brutos em insights acionáveis, apoiando a tomada de decisões estratégicas em várias funções. Esta posição será responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados dentro da divisão, desde a consolidação e análise de dados até o desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards intuitivos. O candidato ideal fará a ponte entre as capacidades técnicas de dados e as necessidades de negócios, atuando como um parceiro confiável para liberar todo o potencial de nossos ativos de dados.

Vaga Corporate com dedicação exclusiva para a divisão L’Oréal Grande Público.

Principais Atividades

  • Análise de Dados para Geração de Insights: realizar análises de dados abrangentes, desde solicitações ad-hoc simples até investigações de alta complexidade, para identificar tendências, padrões e insights acionáveis relevantes para os objetivos de negócios da DPGP.
  • Apoiar projetos analíticos complexos, coletando requisitos, preparando dados e contribuindo para a modelagem analítica sob orientação sênior.
  • Traduzir descobertas analíticas complexas em outputs claros, concisos e acionáveis para as partes interessadas do negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento e Manutenção de Dashboards: projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards interativos (ex: usando Power BI) para visualizar Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) e métricas operacionais para a divisão.
  • Garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados em todas as ferramentas e dashboards de relatórios.
  • Colaborar com o Data Stewards para garantir a adesão às políticas de governança de dados e padrões de qualidade de dados.
  • Suporte à Gestão e Governança de Dados: auxiliar na garantia da qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados divisionais, apoiando os esforços de limpeza e validação de dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe Central de Dados e os Data Stewards das divisões para implementar e monitorar estruturas de governança de dados.
  • Parceria e Comunicação com Stakeholders: atuar como ponto de contato principal para solicitações de dados e análises dentro da divisão DPGP, compreendendo os desafios de negócios e traduzindo-os em requisitos de dados.
  • Comunicar os insights de dados de forma eficaz para diversas audiências, incluindo stakeholders não técnicos, por meio de apresentações envolventes e storytelling visual.
  • Otimização de Processos e Automação: identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos de dados, automatizar relatórios e aprimorar as capacidades de tomada de decisão baseadas em dados dentro da divisão.
  • Contribuir para a definição e aderência aos SLAs para análise de dados e entrega de dashboards.
  • Implementação de Projetos Globais e Regionais: participar ativamente e liderar a implementação local de projetos de dados globais e regionais.
  • Garantir a adoção local, ativação e curadoria contínua dos dados relacionados a essas iniciativas.
  • Conduzir o rollout bem-sucedido dos projetos, com foco em assegurar sua escalabilidade, rentabilidade e relevância local.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Experiência em análise de dados, business intelligence ou função analítica similar.
  • Proficiência em SQL, ETL, Python, LLM e IA para extração e manipulação de dados não estruturados.
  • Experiência em pelo menos uma ferramenta líder de Business Intelligence (ex: Power BI) para desenvolvimento de dashboards e visualização de dados.
  • Habilidades avançadas em Excel.
  • Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de data warehousing e princípios de modelagem de dados.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de pensamento crítico.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e interpessoais, com a capacidade de explicar conceitos complexos e técnicos de forma clara.
  • Atitude proativa, orientada a detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar

  • Possibilidades de crescimentos, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients, collaborating with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management and Fund administration.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. You will be one of the key contributors improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions in a challenging product area.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade features for the Unified Experience for PE.
  • Build and shape front-end and/or full-stack solutions using ReactJS, TypeScript, and related tooling.
  • Champion scalable architectures, SOA/microservices concepts, and data-driven approaches to improve user experience for Private Equity clients.
  • Engage with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing to deliver customer value and refine requirements.

About You

  • You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:
  • 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • Experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • Passion for elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, TypeScript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • Interest in AI/ML technologies and how they can improve product experiences.
  • A desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to own your work end-to-end.
  • Willingness to move fast while building for the future.

Disclosures

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

Desenvolver e gerar novos leads observando as tendências, conduzindo pesquisas, identificando as oportunidades, prospectando por telefone e encontros. Desenvolver a comunicação e programas de formação para informar às equipes comerciais e de marketing sobre o lançamento de novos produtos e mudanças na estratégia organizacional. Desenvolver processos e procedimentos para otimizar os esforços de gestão de contas e atingir as metas de vendas.
  • Gestão de oportunidades: Desenvolver planos de ação comercial para atingir leads e convertê-los em vendas. Gerenciar o próprio território por meio da alocação de equipes e recursos. Desenvolver e manter planos territoriais de médio prazo. Coletar e disseminar informações comerciais sobre concorrência do mercado. Manter e atualizar listas de clientes-alvo. Participar da geração estratégica de leads e do desenvolvimento de mercados-alvo. Identificar o potencial de novas atividades rentáveis em mercados específicos. Monitorar os acordos de parceria para garantir que os objetivos não percam o foco. Influenciar diferentes parcerias para atingir diversas metas. Analisar informações complexas e identificar padrões e implicações.

Trabalhar com parceiros para a estratégia comercial e o planejamento, a fim de garantir a precisão das previsões, uma otimização das oportunidades e a elaboração de planos para realizar os objetivos da empresa. The Senior Sales Representative drives sales performance for ABS’ maritime training offerings. The Sales professional should be comfortable with ambitious targets, managing customer and partner relationships, and coordinating with regional training centers to broker learning solutions that meet customer needs. The professional will be central in articulating the value of ABS’ innovative maritime training solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction, and leveraging industry insights to position and sell maritime client training.

What You Will Do:

  • Communicate the value of ABS training offerings to external customers, B2B partners, and internal collaborators.
  • Work with ABS regional academy managers to provide sales support and understand customer needs.
  • Own and manage relationships with ABS training customers and serve as the primary point of contact for sales.

  • Actively prospect and generate leads for maritime training customers and conduct on-site client visits.
  • Periodically attend training deliveries to better understand customer profiles and cultivate relationships.

  • Strategically expand the buying relationship by identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.

  • Collaborate with teams across marketing, product management, and service delivery to ensure cohesive client strategies and high satisfaction levels.
  • Utilizes existing software and services for handling Client Relationship Management (CRM).
  • Provide support to consulting, development, and other sales groups as requested.
  • Attend events, client committees, and industry conferences to represent ABS and its training offerings.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, particularly in alternative energy sources and digitalization.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business, Marketing, Maritime Studies, or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years of robust sales experience preferred, within the international shipping industry, with a proven track record of managing and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience and proven ability to sell to training customers in a B2B, for-profit commercial training market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills and strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Willingness to travel to meet clients, attend industry events, and engage with stakeholders across various regions.

The Senior Sales Representative reports to a senior member of management within the ABS Learning Organization and has no direct reports.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Overview

Com o DNA diretamente ligado a moda e a arte, acreditamos em inspirações que acompanham a evolução do comportamento humano. Por isso, buscamos para fazer parte da nossa equipe de talentos pessoas diversas, encantadoras, que sejam fonte de energia e ideias. Há 30 anos LENNY NIEMEYER representa a moda praia brasileira. O lifestyle carioca é característica marcante das peças que vão além dos biquínis e maiôs, com moda pós-praia como roupas, bolsas e sapatos. A sede está localizada em São Cristóvão, no Rio de Janeiro. Atualmente existem mais de 20 lojas distribuídas pelo país. A marca também exporta para diversos países, como Estados Unidos, Inglaterra, França, Espanha, Itália, Japão, Turquia, Portugal e Dubai.

Não encontrou a sua vaga? Inscreva-se aqui no nosso banco de talentos e entraremos em contato assim que uma oportunidade com o seu perfil aparecer. Aqui na Lenny você pode atuar nas seguintes áreas: criativo, administrativo, produção e comercial. Fala pra gente em qual dessas áreas você gostaria de atuar e boa sorte!

  • Ter entre 14 e 24 anos (conforme a legislação do programa);
  • Estar cursando ensino médio ou superior (graduação);
  • Disponibilidade para jornada de 4 horas diárias;
  • Vontade de aprender, responsabilidade e interesse em se desenvolver profissionalmente;
  • Não é necessário ter experiência anterior.

Sobre a empresa

Lenny Niemeyer iniciou sua carreira de estilista em 1979 produzindo biquínis para grifes como Fiorucci, Bee, Richards e Andrea Saletto. Em 1991, Lenny decidiu criar sua própria marca, e no mesmo ano abriu sua primeira loja em Ipanema, no Rio de Janeiro. A marca, que leva seu próprio nome, nasceu para fazer resortwear para uma mulher elegante, que quer se sentir confortável e feminina sem se prender a tendências, tendo o lifestyle carioca como característica marcante das suas peças.

A sede está localizada em São Cristóvão, no Rio de Janeiro. Atualmente existem mais de 20 lojas distribuídas pelo país. A marca também exporta para diversos países, como Estados Unidos, Inglaterra, França, Espanha, Itália, Japão, Turquia, Portugal e Dubai.

Lenny Niemeyer vem representando a moda praia brasileira nas semanas de moda mais expressivas do país, e comemorou os 30 anos da marca em um desfile icônico no São Paulo Fashion Week.

title: Global Maintenance Strategy Lead
description:
Overview


Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.


About Us:


SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.



Purpose



  • As Global Maintenance Strategy Team Lead, you are responsible to guarantee the reliability of the units, through reliability studies and maintenance strategy review, reducing the breakdowns and costs, increasing the revenue.

  • You provide guidance and business rules for strategy standardization to the fleet.



Responsibilities



  • You develop a Maintenance Strategy and keep it updated taking into account lessons learned from the Fleet.

  • You develop and oversee the implementation of maintenance strategies to ensure equipment reliability and minimize downtime.

  • You ensure efficient and optimized execution of the maintenance and reliability considering practical, technical and financial constraints.

  • You create and enforce maintenance policies and procedures to improve efficiency and safety.

  • You support to create, implement, update and monitor the Maintenance System plus the continuous improvement of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

  • You provide guidance for FCA Analysis.

  • You are the garant of the Governance of change requests management.

  • You ensure the Maintenance & reliability team has clear objectives.

  • You provide support and opportunities for individual and team development.

  • You lead and mentor the maintenance team, including strategy engineers and reliability engineers, to align their efforts with organizational goals.



Education



  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field.



Experience



  • Experience in maintenance management

  • Oil and gas experience (desired)

  • Strong knowledge of reliability analysis, Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analysis, and asset management.



Functional Competencies



  • Integrity and Reliability - Predictive maintenance

  • Analytics and reporting

  • Integrity and Reliability - Maintenance and Preservation Strategy

  • Integrity and Reliability - Computarized Maintenance Management System

  • Change Management

  • Project control

  • Risk Management

  • External benchmark



GENERAL INFORMATION


SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). title: Senior Risk Analyst
description:
Overview


Statkraft is a leading company in hydropower internationally and Europe’s largest generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power and supplies district heating. Statkraft is a global company in energy market operations. Statkraft has 3500 employees in 15 countries.


The main activities of the Business Area Market Operations & IT are energy management for Statkraft’s assets, trading & origination and market access services in Europe, South America and India. In addition, the business area contains local business support, finance & risk support, and IT services. In M there are 750 employees. The market operations of Statkraft are performed in the offices of Amsterdam, Düsseldorf, Stockholm, Istanbul, London, New Delhi, Oslo, Rio de Janeiro and Trondheim.


Your team:


The Finance and Risk operations of Statkraft Markets Brazil is performed in Rio de Janeiro and Florianapolis. This role will be located in Rio de Janeiro.



  • Extremely qualified professionals with excellent knowledge and careers in energy and financial markets

  • Offices located in Rio de Janeiro and in Florianópolis focused on:

  • Power Trading and Origination

  • Business Development and Structuring


Your role as Senior Risk Analyst


Responsible for developing, controlling and reporting Profit / Loss (P / L), market and credit risk metrics, risk methodologies and mitigation strategies. Provide support and guidance to help front office structure their activities towards market and credit risk. Analyze new products and structures. Ensure that all operations are carried out within the established risk limits and that business results are reported accurately.


Main Activities



  • Develop, operate and maintain risk models for Trading & Origination;

  • Monitor and report risk metrics and risk capital allocation/usage of the trading books, ensuring that the total amounts are within the mandates;

  • Review trading related transactions and support front office to measure the impact of new operations on risk metrics, simulating and calculating the impact on Value at Risk (VaR), Profit at Risk (PaR) and credit risk measures;

  • Evaluate and control the credit risk of the counterparties, following the company\'s credit risk policy;

  • Control and report the business financial performance represented by the Profit/Loss (P/L) metrics, through analysis of spreadsheets/systems, ensuring that all input data (data from the energy purchase and sale agreements, inflation, fx and interest curve) are correctly captured and updated;

  • Cooperate with colleagues across departments in Brazil and in Oslo.


Your profile


Graduation: Physics, Engineering, Mathemathics, Quantitative Economics or another quantitative study.


Solid Experience in the risk analysis area.


Language: Advanced English


Statistics and Econometric


Advanced Excel and Programming Skills (python, R)


Knowledge of the Brazilian energy market


Analysis of Financial Statements


Statkraft offers



  • Professional and personal development in an exciting company

  • A positive working environment characterised by competence, responsibility and innovation

  • A diverse workplace with regard to gender, age and cultural background

  • Competitive terms of employment and excellent benefit schemes

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience

Company overview: Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through software for venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform supports 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries and provides tools to build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with solutions designed to enhance the impact of fund CFOs. Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure and creating an end-to-end ERP platform for private markets.

For more information about offices and culture, visit the Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

As a Senior Engineer, you will help build and shape our product for Private Equity clients. You will contribute to improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions. You will collaborate with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and related areas.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team creates a unified, user-friendly experience for investors, including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Key problem areas:

  • Fragmented experience: lack of unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, hindering portfolio overviews.
  • Missing valuations and insights: valuations, holdings, financials, and KPIs are not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers.
  • Cumbersome entry to key products: no streamlined access to essential tools from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected platform workflows: data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting are not well integrated, impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You care deeply about users and build enterprise-grade applications. You work well acrossSolver and Tech Lead archetypes and can transition between hands-on work and leadership. You should meet the following expectations:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience architecting complex SaaS products with SOA and microservices.
  • You are passionate about elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and applying them to improve product experiences.
  • You aspire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You value communication as a strength and want to own your work end-to-end.
  • You are able to move fast while recognizing when to build for the future.

  • Carta is an equal opportunity employer and aims to provide a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for details.
  • For information on data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.
  • All official communications will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to

title: Manager/Specialist - Procurement Strategy (A&M Infra)
description:
Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. O ambiente colaborativo e o trabalho envolvente—guiados pelos valores centrais da A&M de Integridade, Qualidade, Objetividade, Diversão, Recompensa Pessoal e Diversidade Inclusiva—são as razões pelas quais nossos colaboradores adoram trabalhar na A&M.

A Equipe

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de logística, mineração, energia e O&G. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Liderar a execução de frentes de trabalho com propriedade, identificando iniciativas de melhoria, desempenhando papel ativo em todos os aspectos de envolvimento com o cliente;
  • Liderar reuniões e apresentações junto ao nível gerencial e executivo do cliente e da A&M, transmitindo segurança e domínio dos temas abordados;
  • Responder prontamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações críticas para o sucesso das iniciativas;
  • Atuação em diversos projetos e trabalho com vários colegas e clientes em uma variedade de setores e áreas funcionais;
  • Viabilizar articulações efetivas entre lideranças, conquistando alinhamentos e produzindo resultados que atendem aos interesses dos envolvidos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da prática apoiando o desenvolvimento de produto e/ou indústria;
  • Desenvolver a conta que estiver atuando, identificando oportunidades e trabalhando em conjunto com a liderança para transformar em negócios;
  • Ser elo de conexão entre staff e liderança para disseminação de cultura e gestão de questões;
  • Coordenar e garantir adequações às questões administrativas (programação, planilha de vendas, collections, etc.).

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos complexos em ambiente multicultural e corporativo nos setores de mineração e Óleo & Gás, seja em consultorias ou indústrias;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão de projetos e/ou administração ou finanças será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento robusto dos produtos de I&CP;
  • Ao menos uma certificação em gestão de projetos de entidades preconizadas (ex: AACE, PMI, etc);
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Inglês avançado.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. description:
Job description

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Main responsibilities

  • Suportar o tratamento de não conformidades regulatórias advindas de auditorias ANP, Classe, Marinha e auditorias internas junto aos especialistas de cada disciplina com o adequado acompanhamento de planos de ações, execução de ações no prazo e replanejamentos;

  • Elaborar planos de ação para tratamento dos desvios e incorporação aos procedimentos das lições aprendidas;
  • Mapear, padronizar, otimizar e manter atualizados os processos, normas e procedimentos do PRIO Way sob sua responsabilidade como facilitador;
  • Gerir os indicadores de processo e resultados estratégicos e táticos da empresa e suportar análises críticas;
  • Suportar a execução das rotinas e reuniões do escritório, garantindo padronização e ações a serem acompanhadas.

Requirements and skills

Formação acadêmica;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • Experiência e conhecimento em Metodologias de Gestão (PDCA, SDCA, MASP, Desdobramento de Metas, Gerenciamento da Rotina do Dia a dia, Controle Estatístico de Processos, Padronização, etc);
  • Experiências com ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Experiência com tratamento de desvios e anomalias;
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) (Desejável);
  • Desejável conhecimento em desenvolvimento de softwares;
  • Conhecimento regulatório de sistemas de gestão de Óleo e Gás (ANP, IBAMA, etc).

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal is to become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform across all therapeutic areas. We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025. Try Elfie for yourself by downloading it on the App Store or Google Play.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Elfie, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping how our vision translates into meaningful user and business outcomes. You’ll own end-to-end product experiences, from identifying user needs to defining workflows and shaping solutions that drive real impact in healthcare. You will collaborate closely with founders, engineers, and data teams to ship features that are intuitive, scalable, and strategically aligned. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on solving complex problems with clarity, care, and craft.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract – With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare – From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup – Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework – Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays – Real time off
  • Hybrid Working – 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments – Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with founders and the product team to understand business goals, product vision, and service objectives.
  • Translate ideas into clear, actionable design documentation that supports both product specification and engineering implementation.
  • Research, design, and shape end-to-end product experiences for users across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Map out user journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs to explore and communicate design solutions throughout the iterative process.
  • Produce prototypes, visual assets, and interface components to support testing and development.
  • Continuously refine and enhance the product experience based on user insights and feedback.

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a UI/UX or product design role, with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end mobile app design.
  • Proficient in Figma (required), with additional experience in tools like Adobe Suite considered a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across fast-paced environments with strong planning, time management, and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Fluent in English, with clear communication and documentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience in product development is a bonus, especially in software or tech-focused environments.
  • Proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to dive into details to meet goals.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and adapting designs in an iterative, fast-changing product cycle.
  • Solid foundation in visual design, including drawing, color theory, and layout.
  • Portfolio highlights strong visual craft and ability to solve complex interaction problems.
  • Awareness of current trends in mobile UX/UI and game-inspired interfaces. Bonus points for proficiency in Lottie, Rive, or other motion tools.

Why Join Elfie

We’re a global start-up that is mission-led and fiercely product-driven. We’re building something that improves lives with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

What Now?

Apply today for immediate consideration. If you know someone who would be a good fit, we offer a referral reward if your recommendation is hired. Contact Talent Acquisition for more information.

description:
Join to apply for the Access Center Nurse Coordinator role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Clinical Development, Department Chair, or assigned Director, the Nurse Coordinator is a vital clinical leader responsible for supporting high-quality patient care through a combination of direct clinical services (Resource Time ) and care coordination, communication, and planning activities (Coordination Time ). This role ensures safe, efficient, and patient-centered care while improving communication between patients, clinical staff, and providers. The Nurse Coordinator can be assigned to two of the following departments; Surgery, Medicine, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, Neurology, Psychiatry, Family Medicine, Dermatology, Women’s Health, FPP Administration or the Access Center.

Key Responsibilities

Resource Time – Clinical Care & Education

Time allocated for direct patient-facing care and in-clinic clinical responsibilities, including:

  • Attend and make recommendations for departmental huddles and delegation of clinical duties
  • Perform clinical skills, medication administration, and other direct care duties
  • Support daily clinic operations, triage, and patient flow
  • Educate patients and families on health conditions, medications, and follow-up instructions
  • Participate in and deliver in-service training and continuing education to staff
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all clinical activities in the EHR
  • Monitor for quality concerns during clinical care and escalate as needed
  • Support referral management, by triaging referrals against Schedule Advisor protocols
  • Support authorization team, by responding to peer-to-peer requests
  • Provide pre-surgery and pre-procedure patient education
  • Route patients to follow up appointments post discharge
  • Work with the Access Center Nursing team to implement red/yellow/green triage matrix

Coordination Time – Planning, Collaboration & Administrative Support

Time dedicated to activities that support quality and continuity of care, including:

  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and provider collaboration sessions with Providers
  • Review labs, imaging, and patient messages/tasks to support timely follow-up
  • Coordinate patient care across departments during afternoon staffing huddle
  • Support tracking and follow-up of patients with chronic conditions, missed appointments, or abnormal results
  • Engage in quality improvement activities like QSI rounds, chart reviews, and safety checks
  • Maintain accurate records for compliance with clinical guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Assist with patient outreach to support adherence to treatment plans or follow-up appointments
  • Manage prescription refills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Registered RN – Required
  • DC License – Required or within 90 days if active current state license
  • BSN, MSN or MHSA, MPH or equivalent – Preferred
  • Certified in clinical specialty – Preferred
  • 2+ years experience in an academic health system - Preferred
  • 3+ years ambulatory nursing experience or 2 years inpatient experience on a med/surg unit - Required

Core Competencies

  • Patient-centered care and cultural sensitivity
  • Clinical judgment and escalation awareness
  • Effective communication with multidisciplinary teams
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting
  • Attention to detail and commitment to clinical excellence

Work Environment

  • Ambulatory clinical setting with a balance of patient-facing and administrative duties
  • May require sitting, standing, and moving between care areas throughout the day
  • Requires indirect supervision of non-licensed staff and/or medical assistants

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Neste desafio você utilizará a disciplina técnica de arquitetura e repertório para antecipar cenários, avaliar riscos e impactos, e assegurar que todos os projetos estejam alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos do aeroporto, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória e otimização de recursos em um ambiente de alta complexidade e dinamismo, se mantendo atualizado às tendências e tecnologias existentes no mercado da arquitetura e aviação.

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades :

  • Realizar interface com stakeholders para definir e elaborar o programa de necessidades de cada escopo, garantindo alinhamento desde o início do projeto;
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos com uma visão técnica e operacional, alinhando as necessidades do aeroporto às soluções propostas;
  • Desenvolver escopos detalhados, com foco em arquitetura e áreas relacionadas, apresentando clareza e domínio das necessidades a serem contratadas;

  • Criar cronogramas de projeto e execução, considerando prazos internos, janelas operacionais e sazonalidade, de modo a minimizar impactos na experiência dos passageiros;

  • Participar de projetos complexos que demandam alinhamento constante, comunicação eficaz de possíveis desvios e uma visão estratégica na contratação;
  • Fornecer direcionamento técnico ao projeto do início ao fim, atendendo aos prazos, às premissas estabelecidas, realizando vistorias de qualidade e avaliando fornecedores;
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de otimização de custos e análise de valor em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do Capex, sem comprometer a segurança e a qualidade;
  • Realizar handovers claros, organizados e formalizados para as equipes envolvidas, garantindo uma transição eficiente de informações;

  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas, tecnologias e inovações no setor de arquitetura e aviação;

Overview

We are the Latin American branch of Match Group, the world's largest company for dating websites and apps. Our brands include Match.com, Tinder, OkCupid, Par Perfeito, Divino Amor, Our Time, Hinge, Stir, and more. Our mission is to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. We are passionate about love and focused on building and integrating technology to help connect people.

The Match Group brands worldwide include Par Perfeito (a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships), Hinge (an inclusive dating app for real people seeking real-life relationships), POF (a dating site for casual or serious relationships), Match.com (the world's largest dating site), and Tinder (the leading global app to meet new people). Match Growth & Revenue is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This role applies insights to identify wins across our portfolio (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish), drives business impact through analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaborates with Product and Development teams, and conducts quantitative research on how users find love. We work IRL in our Dallas office two days per week.

We believe that the connection starts online, but the real magic happens IRL — and so do our best works.

Responsibilities

  • Liaise with individual brands to understand their business models, track ecosystem trends, and identify opportunities across the portfolio
  • Conceive and conduct quantitative research to better understand user behavior and inform future initiatives
  • Collaborate with Product and Development teams to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery
  • Propose and design tests for discounting, merchandising, and pricing, with a focus on cross-brand applicability
  • Monitor AB tests, identify opportunities for segmentation and iteration, and model long-term ecosystem and revenue impacts
  • Improve consistency and efficiency of internal querying, reporting, and dashboarding processes

Qualifications

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a role related to business analytics or product analytics
  • You are proficient in SQL (MSSQL and/or Redshift preferred)
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Drive apps, especially Excel/Sheets
  • You are proficient in statistical software such as R or Python
  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and modelling techniques
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively on a diverse team
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent knowledge) or higher in business, economics, mathematics, quantitative social sciences, statistics, or related field

Why work with us?

Our mission is to help people find love and happiness and we take great care of our employees.

At Match Group LatAm, you will have:

  • Autonomy to develop in a light, fun, and technologically innovative environment
  • Flexibility for work and hours
  • Competitive salary package and bonuses, according to company policy
  • Competitive meal voucher/meal allowance
  • Health and dental plan, extendable to spouse and dependents (not included for interns)
  • Gympass to support health
  • Home Office Assistance: monthly allowance for home office expenses
  • Incentive to participate in events
  • Udemy for Business: access to over 183,000 online courses on-demand
  • In-Company English: English training with 80% company contribution and 20% employee contribution
  • Annual Check-up for employees aged 40+
  • "Baby Bonding Leave" — 12 weeks of fully paid paternity leave for new parents
  • International Career Opportunities: opportunities to work abroad within Match Group with local autonomy and global support

We hope you feel excited to join our team, with autonomy to bring your ideas to life without bureaucracy or rigid hierarchies. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process, please indicate this to your recruiter.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

  • Experiência em contencioso civil, trabalhista e/ou tributário;

This role requires technical project accounting expertise and strong communication and collaboration skills to work with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

    • Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

    • Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
    • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.

    • Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.
    • Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.
    • Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.
    • Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.
    • Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.
    • Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.
    • Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.
    • Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.
    • Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

Key Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.
  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.
